Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha resides in a presidential suite or residence with a balcony.
Dyukka-birds are considered dead or absent enough that hearing them alive is startling.
The Empire has stationed Purple Endoguard guards around Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha.

plot_events: The scene shifts to Philodendra at dawn.
Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha is awakened by birdsong coming from outside.
She questions how dyukka-birds can be singing if they were believed dead.
She finds the doors to her room standing open.
She discovers her imperial bodyguards asleep in the living room.
She concludes someone put the guards to sleep and wonders who did it.
She opens the balcony curtains and is startled by what she sees.

visual_summary: An opening caption places the scene on Philodendra. At dawn, a dark-haired woman wakes in a luxurious bedroom with sheer curtains and a balcony view. She hears the sweet song of the dyukka-birds and wonders how that can be possible if they are supposed to be dead. She notices her room is open and steps out to find several purple-clad bodyguards collapsed asleep in the living room. Pulling back the balcony curtains, she reacts in surprise.
